div.div:
One order = one item. The OrderItems are embedded as a list attribute: atomic write with a single PutItem, read by Id with GetItem, listed per customer through GSI1 (ProjectionType.ALL, no N+1).
Payment-result consumers: two distinct [LambdaFunction] entry points (one rule each) delegating to the same handler.
